faq.description: Answers to common questions about the Td5 engine in the Land Rover Discovery 2. If yours is not covered, our team can help.

faqs.q: How do you confirm a Td5 engine fits my Discovery 2?
faqs.a: We check the engine number, VIN and registration, then compare the sump, mounts, ancillaries and engine management with the replacement. Defender Td5 engines can differ, so compatibility is confirmed before any engine is supplied.

faqs.q: How do used, reconditioned and rebuilt Td5 engines compare?
faqs.a: A used engine comes from a donor vehicle, a reconditioned engine is stripped and given new wear parts, and a rebuild restores your existing engine. We recommend an option after assessing the fault and vehicle.

faqs.q: Can I buy a Td5 engine for my own mechanic to fit?
faqs.a: Yes. Trade buyers, independent garages, restorers and private customers can buy supply only. Alternatively, choose supply and fit and our technicians will install the engine at our Grays, Essex workshop.

faqs.q: What affects the cost of a Discovery 2 Td5 engine replacement?
faqs.a: The cost depends on the engine option, the condition of your current engine, any parts needed such as injectors, a turbo or a loom, and whether fitting is included. Send your registration or VIN for a written quote.

faqs.q: Is there a warranty on a replacement Td5 engine?
faqs.a: Warranty cover depends on the engine option and whether we carry out the installation. We confirm the exact terms in writing with your quote, so you know what is covered before work begins.

faqs.q: Do you deliver Td5 engines anywhere in the UK?
faqs.a: Yes. We deliver engines throughout the United Kingdom from our Grays workshop. Delivery arrangements and costs are confirmed in your quote, and supply and fit customers can bring their Discovery to us.

faqs.q: How long does a Td5 engine replacement usually take?
faqs.a: The timescale depends on engine availability, whether a rebuild is needed and any additional work found during inspection. We give you an estimated timeframe with your quote and keep you informed throughout.

workshopIntro.title: Repair, Rebuild or Replace Your Td5?
workshopIntro.description: The fault, mileage and value of your Discovery decide the most sensible route. Loom, injector, fuel pressure and turbo faults can usually be repaired individually. If the cylinder head has cracked, the engine has overheated badly or wear is extensive, a rebuild or Land Rover Discovery 2 Td5 engine replacement is often the better choice.
paragraphs: A replacement Td5 needs healthy supporting systems. Where relevant, we inspect the radiator, water pump, viscous fan, hoses, injector loom and ECU connector, fuel pressure regulator and turbo, and renew the oil, filters and coolant before the engine runs.

Send your registration or VIN with a short description of the symptoms. We will confirm compatibility, explain your options and quote for supply only, supply and fit at our Grays workshop, or delivery anywhere in the UK.

engineProblems.title: Common Discovery 2 Td5 Problems
engineProblems.description: The Td5 often shows clear warning signs, and early checks can prevent expensive engine and ECU damage.

cards.title: Oil in the Injector Loom
cards.description: Oil can wick through the injector wiring loom towards the ECU, causing misfires, warning lights and eventual electrical faults if left untreated. We check the loom, connectors and seals.

cards.title: Cylinder Head and Gasket Faults
cards.description: Coolant loss, overheating, white smoke or pressurised hoses may indicate a failing head gasket or a cracked cylinder head on high-mileage engines. We pressure-test the cooling system and head.

cards.title: Injector Wear and Misfires
cards.description: Rough running, smoke, knocking or poor starting can be caused by worn unit injectors, leaking injector seals or electrical connection faults. We test the injectors and inspect seal condition.
cards.action: Fuel rail and injector leak-off test

cards.title: Low Fuel Pressure and Limp Mode
cards.description: Hesitation, power loss or limp mode may relate to a faulty fuel pressure regulator, a weak fuel pump or a blocked fuel filter. We test fuel pressure and delivery.

cards.title: Turbo and Boost Problems
cards.description: Loss of power, whistling, blue smoke or overboost faults can point to turbocharger wear, wastegate problems, boost leaks or sensor faults. We test boost and inspect the turbo.

cards.title: Oil Leaks and Seal Wear
cards.description: Oil dripping from the engine, a burning smell or rising oil use may come from ageing gaskets, the rear crankshaft seal or the sump. We trace leaks and inspect the seals.

engineOverview.title: Land Rover Discovery 2 Td5 Engine: Your Complete Owner's Guide
paragraphs: The Land Rover Discovery 2 Td5 engine is a 2.5-litre five-cylinder turbodiesel with electronically controlled unit injectors and a timing chain. Strong and economical, it is now high-mileage in many vehicles, and injector loom leaks, cylinder head problems, turbo faults and fuel pressure issues lead owners to seek repair or replacement.

The Td5 was also fitted to the Defender, with differences in ancillaries, sump, mounts and engine management calibration. We identify the correct Land Rover Td5 engine for your Discovery 2 by checking the engine number, VIN and registration.

Whether you need a targeted repair, a Td5 engine rebuild or a complete Discovery 2 Td5 engine replacement, our team inspects the vehicle and explains each option. Call us or send your registration for a written quote.
